import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesLocal

/-!
# Principalization on divisor-module sections

Multiplication by a local principal equation identifies divisor-module sections
with sections of the shifted divisor. These comparisons keep the scalar ring
on the ambient open, as needed for the tensor multiplication formula.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

private noncomputable def moduleSectionsIso {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules}
    (e : M ≅ N) (U : Y.Opens) : Γ(M, U) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U)] Γ(N, U) where
  toFun := e.hom.app U
  invFun := e.inv.app U
  left_inv s := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (congrArg (fun f => f.app U) e.hom_inv_id) s
  right_inv s := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (congrArg (fun f => f.app U) e.inv_hom_id) s
  map_add' := (e.hom.app U).hom.map_add
  map_smul' := e.hom.app_smul

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule divisorSectionsModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- Equal divisor coefficients on an open identify its modules of sections,
linearly over the ambient ring of regular functions. -/
noncomputable def divisorModulesSectionsCongr (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (U : X.Opens)
    (hDE : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ U → coeffAt hz D = coeffAt hz E) :
    Γ(divisorModules K D, U) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(divisorModules K E, U) := by
  let e := LinearEquiv.ofEq (divisorSections K D U) (divisorSections K E U)
    (divisorSections_eq_of_coeffAt_eq_on K D E U hDE)
  refine
    { toFun := e
      invFun := e.symm
      left_inv := e.left_inv
      right_inv := e.right_inv
      map_add' := e.map_add
      map_smul' := ?_ }
  intro r s
  by_cases hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty
  · apply divisorSection_ext K
    have he (t : divisorSections K D U) : divisorVal K (e t) = divisorVal K t := rfl
    change divisorVal K (e (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K D) le_rfl r s)) =
      divisorVal K (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K E) le_rfl r (e s))
    rw [he, divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU),
      divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU), he]
  · haveI := divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K (D := E) hU
    exact Subsingleton.elim (α := divisorSections K E U) _ _

@[simp]
lemma divisorVal_divisorModulesSectionsCongr (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (U : X.Opens)
    (hDE : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ U → coeffAt hz D = coeffAt hz E)
    (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) :
    divisorVal K (divisorModulesSectionsCongr K D E U hDE s) = divisorVal K s := rfl

/-- Multiplication by a rational unit gives the section comparison for a
locally principal difference of divisors. -/
noncomputable def divisorModulesSectionsMulEquiv (D E : X.CurveDivisor)
    (q : X.functionFieldˣ) (U : X.Opens)
    (hq : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ U →
      coeffAt hz (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) = coeffAt hz E) :
    Γ(divisorModules K D, U) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(divisorModules K E, U) :=
  (moduleSectionsIso (mulEquivDivisorModules K q D) U).trans
      (divisorModulesSectionsCongr K _ E U hq)

lemma divisorVal_divisorModulesSectionsMulEquiv (D E : X.CurveDivisor)
    (q : X.functionFieldˣ) {U : X.Opens} (hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty)
    (hq : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ U →
      coeffAt hz (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) = coeffAt hz E)
    (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) :
    divisorVal K (divisorModulesSectionsMulEquiv K D E q U hq s) =
      (q : X.functionField) * divisorVal K s := by
  exact divisorVal_mulEquivDivisorModules K q D hU s

/-- The sections of the zero-divisor module are the regular functions. -/
noncomputable def divisorModulesZeroSectionsEquiv (U : X.Opens) :
    Γ(divisorModules K (0 : X.CurveDivisor), U) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(X, U) :=
  moduleSectionsIso (divisorModulesZeroIso K) U

lemma germ_divisorModulesZeroSectionsEquiv {U : X.Opens}
    (hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty) (s : Γ(divisorModules K (0 : X.CurveDivisor), U)) :
    (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)).hom
      (divisorModulesZeroSectionsEquiv K U s) = divisorVal K s := by
  have h := divisorVal_divisorModulesZeroIso_inv K hU
    (divisorModulesZeroSectionsEquiv K U s)
  have hi : (divisorModulesZeroIso K).inv.app U
      (divisorModulesZeroSectionsEquiv K U s) = s := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (congrArg (fun f => f.app U) (divisorModulesZeroIso K).hom_inv_id) s
  rw [hi] at h
  exact h.symm

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
